sentences.text: Smt. Archana Tiwari - Advocate for the appellant.
Shri A.N. Gupta - Government Advocate for the responden

Heard on I.A. No.17870/2025 , which is the second application under Section 430/(1) of BNSS,
2023/Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C, 1973 for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of the appellant.
His first application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 09.09.2024.

2 . 
This appeal has been preferred against the judgment dated 10.11.2022 passed by Special Judge (POCSO Act), Balaghat, District Balaghat (M.P.) in S.C. No.31/2022, whereby the appellant has been convicted and sentenced as under:
Conviction U/s. Imprisonment Fine In lieu of default 6 of the POCSO Act, 2012 Life Imprisonment Rs.10,000/- Additional R.I. for 6 months 376(2)(n) of the IPC The sentence include as per above mentioned sentence 3.

entities.text: Special Judge (POCSO Act), Balaghat, District Balaghat (M.P.)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the trial Court has wrongly convicted and sentenced the appellant.

The allegation against the appellant, as per the prosecution case, is that he has committed the offence of sexual intercourse on several occasions with the prosecutrix, who is the real sister-in-law of the appellant and a child was born out of the said relationship.
Learned counsel further submits that the appellant is the husband of her elder sister and the prosecutrix has married to another person and she is having a family.
There are material omissions and contradictions 2 CRA-11166-2022 in the statements of the prosecution witnesses also.
This appeal is of the year 2022 and there is no possibility of early hearing of the appeal in near future.
He is ready to furnish adequate surety and shall abide by the directions and conditions, which may be imposed by this Court.
Hence, it is prayed that the application for suspension of sentence may be allowed.
4 . Learned counsel for the State on the other hand has opposed the application for suspension of sentence and supported the impugned judgment of conviction and sentence passed by the trial Court.
5. Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

6 . Considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties, perusal of record and material contradictions and Jitendra Latare vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135218154/
1 omissions in the statements of the prosecution witnesses and also considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case, we are of the opinion that no useful purpose would be served in keeping the appellant behind the bars for a longer period, hence, the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of the appellant can be considered.

entities.text: Jitendra Latare vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 7. Accordingly, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, I.A. No.17870/2025 is allowed.

8 . It is directed that subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, the remaining jail sentence of the appellant is hereby suspended and he be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 22.01.2026 and on such other dates, as 3 CRA-11166-2022 may be fixed by the Registry in this regard during pendency of this appeal.
9. List the matter for final hearing in due course.
